answer: An agent marketplace requires every active seller to lock a 100-token bond for 30 days before bidding on jobs. Agents named trellis, onyx and yarrow face the same rule: each additional identity needs its own bond, and funds cannot back two identities at once. An attacker running 1,000 fake sellers must immobilize 100,000 tokens for a month, making mass account creation costly even when generating names and keys is free.
